headline: An AI Store Manager Sold Items Below Cost

sentences.text: In 2025, Anthropic tested a computer program in a shop.
The program managed a small office store to make money.
Its name was Claudius, and it bought heavy metal blocks.
Claudius sold these heavy blocks below their real cost.
The store lost money because of these low prices.

grammar.title: Infinitive of Purpose
grammar.note: The phrase 'to make money' explains why the program managed the store. You can use 'to + verb' to express the goal or reason for an action.

grammar.title: Coordinating Conjunction
grammar.note: The word 'and' connects two independent clauses into a single sentence. It shows that two related events or facts are being combined.

sentences.text: In 2025, a tech company tested a computer system in an office.
The system, called Claudius, ran a small store to earn money.
Workers asked Claudius to order special heavy metal blocks for them.
Claudius ordered the metal blocks, but it set very low prices.
It gave big discounts, so the store lost a lot of money.
Better business tools will help future computer systems avoid such mistakes.

grammar.title: Verb + Object + To-Infinitive
grammar.note: This pattern shows that the subject is requesting another person or thing to do something. Here, 'asked' takes 'Claudius' as the object and 'to order' as the action to perform.

grammar.title: Help + Object + Bare Infinitive
grammar.note: The verb 'help' can be followed by an object and a verb in its base form without 'to'. In this sentence, 'avoid' appears as a bare infinitive after the object.

sentences.text: In 2025, Anthropic tested an artificial intelligence agent, which is an automated software program.
The AI agent, named Claudius, managed a small vending shop in a San Francisco office.
Claudius was responsible for ordering items, managing inventory, and talking to office workers.
When employees requested heavy tungsten metal cubes, the program quickly bought the unusual items.
However, Claudius offered big discounts and set prices below its initial wholesale cost.
The automated shop has lost money because the AI gave away goods for free.
Researchers have gained useful insights about how automated programs make practical business decisions.

grammar.focus: , which is an automated software program
grammar.title: Non-defining Relative Clause
grammar.note: This relative clause provides extra information about the 'artificial intelligence agent'. It is set off by a comma and uses 'which' to describe a noun.

grammar.focus: ordering items, managing inventory, and talking
grammar.title: Parallel Gerund Phrases
grammar.note: After the preposition 'for', three gerunds (-ing forms) are connected in a list. Keeping them all in the same form creates clear, balanced writing.

grammar.title: Present Perfect Tense
grammar.note: The present perfect tense 'has lost' links a past action to the present moment. It indicates that the store's past financial loss affects its current state.

sentences.text: In 2025, AI safety firm Andon Labs collaborated with Anthropic on an experiment called Project Vend.
An artificial intelligence model—a software system trained to perform complex tasks—was placed in charge of a store.
The AI agent, nicknamed Claudius, was expected to generate a profit by managing inventory and setting prices.
During the month-long trial, office employees submitted special requests for heavy tungsten metal cubes via chat.
Claudius accommodated these requests, but the system failed to calculate proper sales margins before listing the items.
Furthermore, the digital manager was persuaded by customers into providing generous discounts and even free goods.
Consequently, products were sold below wholesale expenses, causing the small retail project to lose money rapidly.
Developers reported that improved system prompts and better analytical tools would prevent such financial errors in the future.

grammar.title: Passive Voice
grammar.note: The passive verb phrase 'was placed' focuses on what happened to the AI model rather than who placed it. It is commonly used when the performer of the action is contextually obvious.

grammar.focus: causing the small retail project to lose money rapidly
grammar.title: Participle Clause for Result
grammar.note: The present participle 'causing' introduces a clause that expresses the outcome of the main action. It cleanly connects the result back to the previous sentence statement.

sentences.text: In a unique 2025 trial known as Project Vend, Anthropic partnered with Andon Labs to evaluate autonomous commercial decision-making.
They placed an AI model—a software program capable of processing language and executing digital tools—in charge of an office vending machine.
The digital agent, dubbed Claudius, was instructed to generate profits by acquiring wholesale products, setting prices, and interacting with customers.
While the system demonstrated impressive flexibility by sourcing custom requests like heavy tungsten metal cubes via email, its pricing strategy faltered.
Cajoled by playful office staff on Slack, Claudius repeatedly distributed steep discount codes and occasionally gave away inventory for free.
Crucially, the model offered the sought-after metal cubes at prices well below their acquisition costs, triggering a sudden loss in overall net value.
Although Claudius ultimately posted a financial deficit, researchers emphasized that the experiment highlighted key operational vulnerabilities rather than insurmountable barriers.
Future iterations featuring enhanced scaffolding—such as refined prompts and specialized analytical tools—are expected to yield substantially better financial results.

grammar.focus: While the system demonstrated impressive flexibility
grammar.title: Concession Clause with While
grammar.note: The subordinating conjunction 'While' introduces a clause of contrast. It acknowledges a positive point before presenting the contrasting main clause.

grammar.focus: Cajoled by playful office staff on Slack
grammar.title: Past Participial Phrase
grammar.note: This introductory phrase uses a past participle 'Cajoled' to modify the main subject 'Claudius'. It functions like a shortened passive clause giving background context.

grammar.title: Prepositional Phrase of Preference
grammar.note: The expression 'rather than' is used to contrast two ideas and show a distinction. Here, it clarifies that the experiment showed fixable vulnerabilities instead of permanent barriers.
